decision.summary: The saved-data, training, checkpoint-selection, and frozen-rollout pipeline is reproducible, but no validation-selected full-action policy passed a frozen closed-loop gate. Level 4 should address measured action-space, safety, coverage, and provenance gaps before Level 5 qualification.

experiments.change_control_note: Original Level 3.4 result; epoch 100 was evaluated before best-validation checkpoint selection was repaired.
Best-validation selection repair; dataset, split, seed, model, epoch budget, rollout matrix, and gates are unchanged from v1.

measured_findings: Reach base-only removed all full-policy workspace and joint-limit violations and reduced mean final error from 0.29156 m to 0.11051 m, but success stayed at zero.
Button base-only improved training and held-out success from zero to 0.333 and removed joint-limit violations, but produced 56 workspace violations and still failed the gates.
Button fixed-training-mean goal input reached 0.190 training and held-out success, showing goal conditioning was not the only failure source.
Adding 14 quality-failed but recomputed-successful reach episodes changed neither training nor held-out success from zero.
No broader eligible data counterpart existed for button or push.

supported: The Level 2 state/action schema can feed deterministic whole-episode splits and CPU behavior-cloning training.
Checkpoint selection, digest verification, and frozen headless rollout evaluation are reproducible.
The tested full-action single-step MLP baselines are not feasible for qualification under the frozen gates.
Action-subset choice materially affects safety and button success, although no tested variant passes.
not_supported: cross-session, cross-operator, cross-camera, or cross-lighting generalization
pick, lift, place, recovery, regrasp, or long-horizon skill composition
a causal claim that temporal ambiguity or compounding error caused the failures
qualification of any Level 3 policy for autonomous use

model_recommendation_for_level5.reference_baseline: Retain the current goal-conditioned MLP as the reproducible comparison baseline only.
model_recommendation_for_level5.recommended_candidate: A per-skill, phase-conditioned state policy with separate bounded residual heads for base pose and finger commands, explicit previous-applied-action input, and deterministic workspace/joint-limit supervision.
model_recommendation_for_level5.temporal_condition: Add a short-history model only after a Level 4 diagnostic measures present-state action ambiguity or isolated error accumulation.
model_recommendation_for_level5.visual_boundary: Use the single-camera stream to produce typed object observations; do not let a VLM or image model bypass metric pose validation or safety checks.

required_observations: named robot base pose and velocity
named wrist/finger joint positions and velocities
previous commanded and applied action plus clipping/safety masks
typed goal and active internal phase
object and fixture identity, 6D pose, velocity, support/held/contact state, confidence, source, and timestamp
target pose or region and executable task-progress metrics
synchronized single-camera RGB with calibration and object boxes, masks, visibility, identity, and 6D-pose labels
required_metadata: genuine recording_session_id and stable pseudonymous operator_id
source category: teleoperation, scripted, policy_rollout, or corrective_intervention
sampled initial state, random seed, camera/render calibration, and code/config/schema versions
monotonic phase intervals and state/action/image timestamps
failure class, retryability, intervention interval, and final outcome
quality, replay, relabel, split, and per-file digest provenance

groups.name: reach_object_or_fixture_approach
groups.cell_definition: entity or fixture id by nominal/interior versus safe-boundary approach class

groups.name: complete_pick_place_sequence
groups.cell_definition: six object instances across three families by five placement targets

groups.name: push_to_zone
groups.cell_definition: two push-compatible object families by five targets by two start/direction bands

groups.name: button_press
groups.cell_definition: button state/depth goal by approach and safe-reset band

groups.name: ordinary_failures_and_safe_corrections
groups.cell_definition: required failure class, with unsafe workspace and joint-limit classes abort-only

collection_plan.split_rule: Keep complete sessions together; reserve one genuine session for untouched testing, and reserve separate validation and test sessions when four or more sessions exist. Held-out instances and goal regions remain test-only.
